apps.name: Lumo
apps.subtitle: Free YouTube Music player
apps.localizedDescription: Search and play any song, synced lyrics, offline downloads, playlists you can save from YouTube Music, and recommendations. No ads.

versions.localizedDescription: Nive is now Lumo: new name, new teal look, Save to Library for any playlist or album, and update checks inside the app. Your library is kept.
Nive is now on Android too (APK on the releases page). Library backups move between iPhone, Mac and Android.
Library backup: Settings → Export / Import Library (likes, playlists, stats, downloads list).
